description: This file declares the VsockCameraProvider class, which implements the ICameraProvider interface for Android's camera hardware abstraction layer, specifically for version 2.7. It includes method declarations for camera device management, callback setting, and device state notifications, along with necessary includes and namespace usage.

classes.name: VsockCameraProvider
classes.description: Implementation of the ICameraProvider interface for managing camera devices via virtual socket connections, including callback management, device addition/removal, and device state notifications.
